description: This file defines the HostRepository class with methods for querying and updating host data in a database using Prisma ORM. It includes methods for updating schedules, finding hosts with various filters, pagination, and retrieving credentials.

classes.name: HostRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing host data with various query methods.

methods.name: updateHostsSchedule
methods.description: Updates the schedule ID for multiple hosts based on user ID and old schedule ID.

methods.name: findHostsCreatedInInterval
methods.description: Finds hosts created after a specific start date for given event type and user IDs.

methods.name: findHostsWithLocationOptions
methods.description: Retrieves hosts with location options for a specific event type, including user and credential details.

methods.name: findHostsWithLocationOptionsPaginated
methods.description: Paginated retrieval of hosts with location options for a specific event type.

methods.name: findHostsPaginatedIncludeUser
methods.description: Paginated retrieval of hosts including user info, with optional search.

methods.name: findHostsPaginatedIncludeUserForAssignment
methods.description: Paginated retrieval of hosts for assignment, filtering by member user IDs and search, with fixed host check.

methods.name: findAllRoundRobinHosts
methods.description: Retrieves all non-fixed hosts for round-robin scheduling.

methods.name: findChildrenForAssignmentPaginated
methods.description: Retrieves child event types for assignment with pagination and search.

methods.name: findHostsWithConferencingCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves hosts with conferencing or video credentials for a specific event type.
